
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- main.volt:1[/yellow bold]

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[yellow bold]-- DEAD POLICY -- main.volt:3[/yellow bold]

`try` block has no error-returning statements; `or retry` is dead code.

 [dim]2 |[/dim] hardware { pin led: Output = 4 }
 [dim]3 |[/dim] setup { try { let x: int = 1 } or retry }
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]                  ^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Remove the `try` wrapper, or add a call that can fail (wifi/mqtt/storage/device-init).[/cyan]
